+
+No simulator internals or demonstration data are used.  Run commands by importing

+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+

+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+CAMERAS = [
+    "robot0_agentview_center",
+    "robot0_agentview_left",
+    "robot0_agentview_right",
+    "robot0_eye_in_hand",
+]
+
+
+class Controller:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.robot = Robot()
+        self.spec = self.robot.spec()
+        self.seq = 0
+        (OUT / "runs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        (OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(self.spec, indent=2))
+
+    def observe(self, cameras=None, depth=True, save=True):
+        result = self.robot.get_obs(
+            cameras=CAMERAS if cameras is None else cameras,
+            include_depth=depth,
+            video="none",
+        )
+        if save:
+            result.save(str(OUT / "observations" / f"obs_{self.seq:03d}"))
+        return result
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def q_from(result):
+        return np.asarray(result.meta["proprio"]["now"][4:11], dtype=float)
+
+    def submit(self, rows, note="", cameras=None, video="none", depth=False):
+        rows = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
+        self.seq += 1
+        result = self.robot.submit(
+            "joint_position",
+            rows,
+            dt=self.spec["control_dt"],
+            interpolate="linear",
+            cameras=(CAMERAS if cameras is None else cameras),
+            video=video,
+            include_depth=depth,
+            note=note,
+        )
+        run_dir = OUT / "runs" / f"{self.seq:03d}"
+        result.save(str(run_dir))
+        np.save(run_dir / "actions.npy", rows)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "note": note,
+            "control_steps": result.meta.get("control_steps"),
+            "time_left_s": result.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+            "done": result.meta.get("done"),
+            "q": self.q_from(result).tolist(),
+            "eef_xyz": result.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[26:29],
+        }))
+        return result
+
+    def hold(self, q=None, grip=1.0, steps=10, note="hold", cameras=None):
+        """Hold an arm target; base/torso zero, arm mode."""
+        if q is None:
+            obs = self.robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
+            q = self.q_from(obs)
+        a = np.zeros((steps, 13), dtype=np.float64)
+        a[:, :7] = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+        a[:, 7] = grip
+        a[:, 12] = -1.0
+        return self.submit(a, note=note, cameras=cameras)
+
+
